settings.quotaWindowSync.title: Start five-hour windows together
settings.quotaWindowSync.description: After you use an account, send one short request to other available accounts whose five-hour windows have not started, so their allowances refresh at roughly the same time.
settings.quotaWindowSync.hint: Uses a small amount of allowance. Accounts with running windows, disabled accounts, and accounts with no weekly allowance are skipped. The service determines reset times.

settings.quotaWindowSync.cloudHint: On the computer managing these accounts, enable “Start five-hour windows together” in Settings. Remote chats through that computer will also trigger it. Set this up separately on each computer.
